messages:
Meera Patel: quick handoff — i'm taking primary for the midnight window but ran into a couple of access issues. PagerDuty escalation key for inference-prod is prompting MFA and my device isn't accepting the OTP. Grafana: I only have Viewer, can't silence/ack alerts. AWS assume-role seems OK. Can someone confirm secondary coverage and help with Grafana/PagerDuty perms? I'll start the runbook check-list while we sort perms.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · inference-serving-prod · P1 · increased 5xx rate · paged: primary (Meera Patel) · incident id: INC-2026-8473 · https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-8473

Alex Chen: I can be secondary for the first 2 hours. I just validated PagerDuty access (can see the on-call schedule) and Grafana edit for alerts works for me. Meera — try a PagerDuty test, but don't escalate to customers. Quick PD check: `open https://app.pagerduty.com/oncalls` or run `pd whoami` if you have the CLI.

Meera Patel: thanks Alex. PD CLI shows me as unauthenticated. When I try web login it asks for OTP and times out.

Jonas Berg: APAC overlap gap — our on-call rotation ends 00:30 UTC and APAC midnight coverage is thin after that. If Meera is primary we need to ensure the auto-fallback policy is set: inference-prod -> fallback: inference-standby. Can someone confirm policy? Also Meera, if you can't get PD login, use the emergency PD key in LastPass (ops-team/emergency-keys) and rotate after.

Sara Lopez: Meera — i just checked Grafana roles. You had Viewer because the invite used the org group `eng-readonly`. I'm switching you to `edit` on `grafana-prod` now. Ping me if you still can't mute alerts. :white_check_mark:

Meera Patel: Sara — tried mute, still blocked. Getting 403 on ack.

Sara Lopez: applying a direct role now (edit) — give it 30s. Also adding a note: if you need temporary admin we have `infra-requests` for elevated access with justification. Link: https://wiki.redwood.example/infra-requests

Alex Chen: while permissions propagate — Meera, here's a minimal PD test you can run from dev machine (no customer impact):

```
# trigger a test alert by creating a low-severity incident in PD (events API v2)
curl -X POST "https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"routing_key":"<TEST_INTEGRATION_KEY>","event_action":"trigger","payload":{"summary":"oncall test - do not escalate","severity":"warning"}}'
```
Replace <TEST_INTEGRATION_KEY> with the test key from LastPass.

Meera Patel: ran the test with the emergency key, got the test alert in PD UI. I can now acknowledge and escalate. Grafana ack still 403 but i can view the alert.

ops-oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook -> Oncall Handoff (https://wiki.redwood.example/runbooks/oncall-handoff). Steps 1-6 should be completed during handoff.

Jonas Berg: re: AWS access — Meera, confirm with `aws sts get-caller-identity`. If you need to assume the oncall role:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name meera-oncall
```
Then export the returned creds.

Meera Patel: `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns the expected principal — assume-role is OK.

Sara Lopez: Grafana ack fixed — there was a caching TTL in our IAM sync. You should be able to silence the alert now.

Meera Patel: confirmed — I can silence and add a note. Update on incident: 5xx rate dropped after rolling back the last inference model rollout. Watching metrics.

Alex Chen: confirmed secondary coverage. I'll stay on for 2 hours and can take primary if you need a break.

Meera Patel: handoff checklist complete: PagerDuty test ✅, Grafana ack/silence ✅, AWS assume-role ✅, runbook link checked ✅. Primary: Meera Patel (00:00–02:00 UTC). Secondary: Alex Chen (00:00–02:00 UTC). Coverage note: APAC gap from 02:00–06:00 UTC — need follow-up to ensure rotation.

Jonas Berg: adding follow-up action: ticket to patch oncall rota for APAC coverage and add runbook step to validate PagerDuty emergency key rotation.

Sara Lopez: created infra ticket #OPS-4129 for APAC rota and perms audit.

Meera Patel: thanks team. I'll update the incident timeline and close the handoff message here. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall-bot: Handoff complete recorded by bot. Handoff_ts: 2809991165"
